title: First colony to Origo (Carthage)
summary: Sidonian or Tyrian settlers first colonize the site of Carthage, called Origo.
description: Sidonian or Tyrian settlers first colonize the site of Carthage, called Origo. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 3 (Table 2, row 1233, p. 46).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 3): 1233 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 3: The Founding Dates of Tyre and Carthage," OSF preprint v1.2 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9V65S, Table 2, row 1233, p. 46
chronologies.note: First colony sent to Origo (Carthage), before the Fall of Troy (Appian, Philistus).
